Sri Ashwani Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to set side the impugned order dated 27.02.2023 passed by Special Judge (D.A.A.)/IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Kanpur Nagar in S.S.T. No.188 of 2021, arising out of Case Crime No.323 of 2020, under Sections 419, 420 IPC, Police Station Chaubepur, District Kanpur Nagar.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Submission of learned counsel for the applicants is that in the instant case, without making compliance of the provisions of Section 207 Cr.P.C. charge against the accused persons has been framed, which vitiate the entire proceedings against the accused persons.

On the aforesaid ground,
prayer made to set aside the charge framing dated 27.02.2023.
Further submission is that the case is triable by Magistrate but cognizance has been taken by the court of Sessions, which is barred by Section 193 Cr.P.C..
On the other hand, learned AGA has opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: Keeping in view the entire facts and circumstances of the case as well as the order sheet of the entire proceedings of the case has been filed through supplementary affidavit, which no where reflects that accused have been furnished with the copy of the police report and documents in compliance of the provisions of Section 207 Cr.P.C..

The provisions of Section 207 Cr.P.C. are incorporated to give effect the concept of fair trial which is all pervading component of a criminal case and accused persons cannot be deprived of their rights/aspirations of fair trial.

In absence of acknowledgement of the accused-petitioners regarding receipt of copies under Section 207 Cr.P.C., charge has been framed without compliance of provisions of Section 207 Cr.P.C., it shows that ample opportunity has been refused to the accused person at the stage of framing of charge, which causes the entire trial vitiated and the same is nothing but an abuse of process of law..
In view of the such facts, the charge framed and impugned order dated 27.02.2023 passed by Special Judge (D.A.A.)/IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Kanpur Nagar is here by set aside.

entities.text: Special Judge (D.A.A.)/IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is directed the trial court after making compliance of the provisions of Section 207 Cr.P.C. shall hear the accused persons at the point of charge and pass appropriate order in accordance with law.
Accordingly, the instant application stands disposed off.
